name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao's path to motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a degree in accountancy and a brief stint at a multinational corporation. However, his passion for racing, ignited by watching Formula 1 races as a child, led him to seek opportunities where his financial acumen could intersect with his love for speed. He started by volunteering at local racing events, eventually securing a role managing the finances of a smaller racing team before being headhunted by Team Gtechniq.

As finance controller, Jian Hao is meticulous and detail-oriented, understanding that every dollar saved or wisely invested can translate to crucial performance gains on the track. He believes in a transparent and data-driven approach, providing the team with clear financial insights to inform strategic decisions. He is also known for his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising the team's competitive edge. His ambition is to one day become CFO of a major racing organization.

What distinguishes Jian Hao is his relentless pursuit of financial optimization. He constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation. He views the finance department not just as a support function, but as a strategic partner in the team's pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Jian Hao is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized financial spreadsheet on his tablet, even during team social events.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often in time with engine sounds.
Insists on using physical calculators alongside financial software as a failsafe.
